title: Authenticated DIO issuance omits signer/source and root key binding
description: python/src/lichen/rpl/authenticated_dio.py::_issue_authenticated_dio_from_ipv6 seals AuthenticatedDio after checksum/instance/DODAG/MOP/role checks but does not require the decompressed IPv6 source to be fe80:: plus the authenticated signer's IID, nor (for expected_role=root) require DODAGID == AddrForKey(signer). Those checks exist only in DodagState's routing consumer. DioTimeVerifier and LinkLayer.accept_authenticated_schc_dio trust the sealed object directly, so an authorized link signer can obtain time/SCHC-policy evidence for a DIO asserting another source (and a root can assert a DODAG not derived from its key). The packets-timing wrong-signer test explicitly short-circuits before calling production admission, so it does not regress this. Enforce both identity bindings at sealed issuance for unfragmented and fragmented DIOs, then make routing/time/SCHC consumers share the same rejection vectors.
